method.authoritative_metadata: MRD-embedded PPR describes the acquisition; adjacent PPR and planned-PPR differences are retained explicitly.
method.counter: Hardware performance counter, relative chronology only; not a civil timestamp.
method.payload: Dimensions and datatype from binary MRD header; exact 120-byte interstitial region and nonzero experiment/slice blocks checked.
method.plan_comparison: Embedded values vs the planned PPR (experiments/2026-10-09_exvivo_plan); scan K is compared against plan A. Runtime-only records (gains, delays, masks) occur only in MRDs and are listed separately. Active comparison trims acquisition arrays at no_diff_acq and omits the mode-1 acq_grad cache.
method.active_pair_comparison: Acquisition arrays trimmed at no_diff_acq; mode-1 acq_grad inactive cache omitted. Full stored arrays/raw record differences retained separately.
method.source_identity: Embedded PPL paths name releases but contain no source hashes; repository source hashes identify repository copies, not a proven scanner build.
